children: Coya Therapeutics announced full enrollment of 120 patients in its Phase 2/3 ALSTARS trial of COYA 302, with topline data from the double‑blind phase expected in early Q2 2027.
ALSTARS reached planned enrollment of 120 patients for evaluation of COYA 302 in ALS; additional screened participants may enroll if eligible.
The randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled study compares two COYA 302 dosing regimens versus placebo over a 24‑week treatment phase.
Primary endpoint is change in ALSFRS‑R total score from baseline to Week 24 versus placebo; study also assesses safety, biomarkers and biological activity.
Patients completing the 24‑week phase enter a 24‑week blinded active‑treatment extension, providing up to 48 weeks of COYA 302 data.
